title: BridgeDestroyed
description: A bridge's HP reached 0 (CONTRACTS 6; STATE-MACHINES 4.3, COMBAT CB-10; NX-373): its road edge is cut for path planning until it is repaired to full. Once per down cycle, never per hit; individual hits are WeaponImpact.

by_id.description: The unit whose hit took the bridge to 0; null for a hidden actor in a filtered view.
